instruction: Cinematic medium-wide shot from a low angle of a couple practicing yoga outdoors under a cloudy sky. On the right, the woman with buzzed hair (R1) in a beige sports bra and grey shorts holds a warrior pose with arms outstretched. On the left, the bearded man (R2) in a white t-shirt and black leggings holds the same pose facing the opposite direction. Soft, overcast daylight illuminates the scene with muted natural tones.
